description: Nawagathegama Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Roads and Thoroughfares for the Nawagathegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the confirmation and declaration of roads and thoroughfares as owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Nawagaththegama local government authority. It involves legal determinations of property ownership, references to judicial decrees regarding land titles, and the formal registration of these roads as municipal property. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other administrative matters.
